name: @workerv2/app
description: Worker V2 deployable application (Phase 19.5) — the minimal executable process that composes the existing production runtime (@workerv2/worker-runtime) into a runnable worker service for local, Docker, and Render execution. It only bootstraps + drives existing libraries: it duplicates no runtime logic and modifies no completed architecture. Loads RuntimeConfig from env, constructs WorkerRuntime, recovers unfinished work, consumes jobs from a replaceable queue adapter, and shuts down gracefully on SIGINT/SIGTERM.
